cohort: 403 singleton pregnant women who underwent pharmacological labor induction at term
finding: Intracervical dinoprostone appears to be safer but less effective in labor induction than vaginal misoprostol, while combining methods increases efficacy.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the rate of C-sections between dinoprostone and misoprostol cohorts, but C-section due to birth asphyxia was insignificantly more frequent in the group receiving dinoprostone followed by Foley catheter and misoprostol compared to the group receiving dinoprostone and Foley catheter.
